Redwood Lakeside

Villa in Bang Tao
HomeNew ProjectsRedwood Lakeside

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A lakeside villa enclave by Redwood Luxury near Bang Tao, with 3 and 4 bedroom villas on plots of 400 to 902 sqm. Four villa types (Palm, Orchid, Lotus, Lily) include single-storey and two-storey designs, each with a private pool. Heavy landscaping and a shuttle to local beach and shopping hubs are part of the offer.

Facilities & amenities

  • Community center and event spaces
  • Lakeside parks, lawns, walking trails
  • Playgrounds
  • Cafes and restaurant areas
  • Free shuttle to Bang Tao Beach, Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket
  • Double-wall construction with thermal insulation
  • Optional hybrid solar system
  • Smart home integration

Frequently asked questions

Where is Redwood Lakeside?

Redwood Lakeside is a pool villa project in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Redwood Luxury.

What is the starting price of Redwood Lakeside?

The advertised starting price is ฿37,400,000, last checked 2026-11-12. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Redwood Lakeside?

Sources list leasehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Redwood Lakeside be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
